subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Others chose longer books they truly liked.”?
options: At the end of the week, the teacher asked what they had learned.
At the end of summer, the librarian asked children to share their favorite book.
Children can enter after school, read quietly, and borrow one book at a time.
The librarian says a seed library and a book library are not so different.
